Long-form brief delivered within 24h: ~1500 words (1200-2000), executive summary + key findings + analysis, at least 8 cited public sources, operator-checked. Returns job id + dueBy; poll GET /v1/jobs/:id (free) for {title, summary, body_markdown, sources, word_count}. Free sample: /samples/brief-x402-bazaar-discovery.md Price: $9.00 USDC per call (x402 on Base) or 1 prepaid pack credit. Failed calls aren't charged when you pay per call with x402: if the job errors, the USDC payment is never settled. With pack credits (X-Entitlement-Key), a call that fails gives its credit back.
